channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Democrats vow to end Trump presidency if they win House
item.description: The top House Democrat said Thursday that Democrats would effectively end Trump's presidency if they win chamber control in the midterms.

item.title: Law Firm Sues Dearborn, Michigan Over Religious Discrimination
item.description: The complaint alleges courts have identified a pattern in Dearborn of favoring Islam over other religions, violating U.S. law.

item.title: Zara Larsson Criticizes White House Over ICE Video Using Her Song
item.description: Pop singer Zara Larsson criticized the White House for using her song in a video, calling them "such f-----g losers" and saying it was "crazy."

item.title: Trump's Plan To Stop Noncitizens From Rigging The Census Might Work This Time
item.description: The Trump administration has proposed a rule change that could finally deliver on the principle of 'one man, one vote.'
